parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number for a paged query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: **500**.

parameters.name: RecordMatchType
parameters.description:
The matching mode used to filter by record name. Valid values:
- **fuzzy**: fuzzy match.
- **prefix**: prefix match.
- **suffix**: suffix match.
- **exact**: exact match (default).

parameters.name: RecordName
parameters.description: Filters by the specified record name.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.
